description: Bounded graph read over life_updates (PHI-54/61): traverse interaction → person/event/expense/place with source/confidence on every hop. When life_update edges are missing, projects hops from CRM interactions, event_people, and expense person FKs (PHI-100). Prefer for “who was I with at X?”, “when am I meeting Y next?”, “how much at Z?”. 93-day default window. Pass person_name, place_query, or ids. Records carry inspect_url (their Dayze page): cite with it, never build a link from an id; a record without one has no page (inspect_note says which). ($0.10; API key required)
name: get_interactions
